subject: Mathematics
textbook: Balbharati Mathematics & Statistics Part I and Part II (Arts & Science)
purpose: Spiral chapter plan (spine) for Std XII. Approach: option (b) light refactor - board chapters preserved, only fused chapters split; then reordered so NDA-tested chapters lead (the NDA-first priority) and the three non-NDA (CET-only) chapters drop to a droppable tail. Deep-dive subtopic/concept/source mappings live in maths-xii-deep-dive.json, keyed by unit_no.
session_model: Session estimates TBD (no refactored source doc for XII yet).
notes: Why NDA-prioritized: LWS is an NDA-first institute; NDA-tested chapters lead and the three non-NDA (CET-only) chapters - Mathematical Logic, Pair of Straight Lines, Linear Programming - sit in a droppable tail (Units 18-20).

Order is deliberately SPACED & INTERLEAVED for retention (distributed-practice / desirable-difficulties evidence): the three Differentiation stages are split across the plan (Units 2, 5, 6) and probability/trig units are interspersed rather than blocked. Board chapter numbers are preserved in board_source for cross-reference.

Binomial Distributions (Unit 12) precedes Probability Distributions (Unit 19): weakly dependent for a formula-driven exam: teach E(X)/Var(X) briefly in the Binomial unit (or state mean=np, variance=npq), then close the loop when Probability Distributions is later taught.

Two fused board chapters are split: Trigonometric Functions -> Trig Equations + Solution of Triangles + Inverse Trig; Differentiation (64pp) -> 3 stages. Height & Distance is an NDA-supplementary unit (board covers it in Class 10).

Subtopic-level NDA split: Application of Derivatives is split into an NDA core (Unit 7) and a deferred CET-Extension (Unit 18: Rolle/MVT, approximations, angle-between-curves). Probability Distributions (Unit 19) is entirely CET (NDA has no distributions chapter) and joins the deferred block. Tetrahedron (in Line & Planes) and DE growth/decay applications are tagged CET-only/CET-leaning in place. Sphere (Unit 10) is added as an NDA-supplementary topic after Line & Planes.
Deferred CET block = Units 18-22 (AoD CET-Extension, Probability Distributions, Mathematical Logic, Pair of Straight Lines, Linear Programming); a pure-NDA student can stop after Unit 17.

guiding_principles.meaning: Units are sequenced so NDA-tested content comes first; everything NDA does not test - the AoD CET-Extension, Probability Distributions, Mathematical Logic, Pair of Straight Lines and Linear Programming - is placed in a deferred CET block (Units 18-22) a pure-NDA student can drop.
The XII board order is already dependency-sound, so units are resequenced for variety/retention (spacing + interleaving) rather than to fix dependencies; every hard prerequisite is still respected.

Trigonometric Functions (board Ch3) fuses trig equations + solution of triangles + inverse trig -> 3 units. Differentiation (board P2-Ch1, 64pp) is split into rules/chain, log/implicit/parametric, and higher-order -> 3 units.

Topics NDA tests but the board omits (Binary Numbers, Height & Distance, Sphere) or only embeds/assumes (Logarithms, Quadratic Equations, Linear Inequalities, Regression) have been FITTED into the plans - 5 in XI, plus Height & Distance and Sphere in XII; see the Supplementary NDA Topics record.

phases.name: NDA Core (priority)
phases.blurb: The 17 NDA-core units (including Sphere), resequenced for spacing & interleaving (not board order). High-yield for NDA and MHT-CET both; taught first. A pure-NDA student can stop after Unit 17.

phases.name: CET-Only Tail (droppable for NDA)
phases.blurb: The 5 deferred units NDA does not test: Application of Derivatives - CET Extension, Probability Distributions, Mathematical Logic, Pair of Straight Lines, Linear Programming. Required for MHT-CET; droppable for a pure-NDA student.

units.title: Inverse Trigonometric Functions
units.why_here: Principal values, properties, inverse-trig identities; prerequisite for inverse-function differentiation (Unit 2, Differentiation). Maps to NDA Inverse Trigonometry. Split out of board Ch3.

units.title: Differentiation - Rules, Chain & Inverse-Function Derivatives
units.why_here: Chain rule, composite and inverse-function derivatives; needs Inverse Trig (Unit 1, Inverse Trig). First stage of the split mega-chapter. Maps to NDA Differentiation.

units.title: Matrices
units.why_here: Matrix inverse (elementary transformation + adjoint) and solving linear systems (inversion/reduction); maps to NDA Matrices & Determinants, one of NDA's heaviest chapters.

units.title: Differentiation - Logarithmic, Implicit & Parametric
units.why_here: Logarithmic, implicit and parametric differentiation; second stage of the split.

units.title: Differentiation - Higher-Order Derivatives
units.why_here: Second and higher-order derivatives; third stage of the split.

units.title: Vectors
units.why_here: Dot/cross/triple products, vector geometry; a top-weighted chapter for both NDA (Vectors) and MHT-CET. Precedes Line & Planes.

units.title: Application of Derivatives
units.why_here: The NDA-core applications - rate of change, tangents/normals, increasing-decreasing, maxima-minima. (Rolle/MVT, approximations and angle-between-curves are split into the CET-Extension unit for NDA students to skip.)

units.title: Indefinite Integration
units.why_here: Integration methods (substitution, parts, partial fractions); maps to NDA Indefinite Integration.

units.title: Line & Planes
units.why_here: 3-D lines and planes; needs Vectors. Maps to NDA 3-D Geometry.

units.title: Sphere
units.why_here: [NDA-supplementary] NDA 3-D Geometry weights the sphere (20 PYQs); the board's Line & Planes chapter has no sphere. Placed directly after Line & Planes.

units.title: Definite Integration
units.why_here: Definite integrals + properties; needs Indefinite Integration. Maps to NDA Definite Integration.

units.title: Binomial Distributions
units.why_here: Bernoulli trials, B(n,p), mean/variance; maps to NDA Binomial Distribution. Closes the NDA core. NOTE: taught before Probability Distributions (Unit 19) - the only prerequisite (E(X)/Var(X) of a random variable) is bootstrapped locally here or stated as np/npq, then back-linked when Probability Distributions is taught.

units.title: Application of Definite Integration
units.why_here: Area under/between curves; needs Definite Integration. Maps to NDA Applications of Integration.

units.title: Solution of Triangles
units.why_here: Sine / cosine / projection rules; maps to NDA Properties of Triangle. Split out of board Ch3.

units.title: Differential Equations
units.why_here: Order/degree, formation, variable-separable, linear, applications; needs Integration. Heavy for both exams.

units.title: Trigonometric Equations
units.why_here: General solutions of trig equations; maps to NDA Trigonometric Equations. Split out of the fused board Ch3.

units.title: Height & Distance
units.board_source: NDA-supplementary - board covers in Class 10 SSC
units.why_here: [NDA-supplementary] Application of trigonometry (angles of elevation/depression; 24 PYQs); Maharashtra teaches it in Class 10, so it needs a +2 revision unit for NDA. Placed after Solution of Triangles (uses sine/cosine rules).

units.title: Application of Derivatives - CET Extension
units.board_source: Part II, Ch. 2 §2.2 Approximations + §2.3 Rolle/LMVT (CET-only subtopics)
units.why_here: [CET-only] Rolle's & MVT, approximations, and angle between curves - CET-tested (~37 PYQs) but not in NDA. Split out of Application of Derivatives (Unit 7) and deferred so NDA students can skip.

units.title: Probability Distributions
units.why_here: [CET-only] Random variables, PMF, expectation, PDF - CET-tested (~68 PYQs); NDA has no random-variable/distribution chapter (its probability is counting/conditional/Bayes at XI). Binomial (Unit 12) is the NDA-tested distribution; deferred here for CET.

units.title: Mathematical Logic
units.why_here: CET-only: statements, truth tables, logical equivalence, switching circuits (~88 MHT-CET PYQs). Not tested by NDA and not in NCERT. Self-contained -> deferrable/droppable for a pure-NDA student.

units.title: Pair of Straight Lines
units.why_here: CET-only: combined equation, angle, distance of a pair of lines (~45 MHT-CET PYQs). Not tested by NDA (which does single lines) and not in NCERT. Extends XI Straight Line.

units.title: Linear Programming
units.why_here: CET-only for exams: feasible region, objective function optimisation (~46 MHT-CET PYQs). In NCERT-12 but not tested by NDA. Dependency-independent -> flexible/relief placement.
